verdict.rationale: Kick documents automation rules, an Activity audit trail that logs AI and rule actions, and approval of MCP-driven changes. None of these provides versioning, change review, or rollback of the automations themselves. The audit trail and approval flow are adjacent controls that log or gate actions; they do not keep versions of rules or let you revert them, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
